# fragland.dev

> > A multi-domain content hub covering D&D Beyond's official digital toolset, Know Your Meme's viral culture documentation, and TV Guide's streaming and entertainment listings.

This site aggregates content from three major platforms: D&D Beyond (official Dungeons & Dragons digital tools and rules), Know Your Meme (internet culture and viral trend explanations), and TV Guide (television schedules and streaming recommendations). It serves as a unified reference for tabletop gaming, meme culture, and entertainment media.

## Key Topics

- D&D Beyond
- Dungeons & Dragons
- Fifth Edition (5e)
- Character Creation
- Basic Rules
- Know Your Meme
- TikTok Trends
- Viral Memes
- TV Guide
- Netflix
- Streaming Services
- TV Schedules
- Entertainment News
- Meme Explanation
- Getting Started with D&D

## D&D Core Tools & Getting Started

- [D&D Beyond | Play Your Way With the Official D&D Toolset](https://dndbeyond.com): Homepage featuring Digital Character Builder and Maps VTT for D&D play
- [How to Play D&D](https://dndbeyond.com/en/how-to-play-dnd): Beginner's guide to D&D: roleplay characters, Dungeon Master, find groups
- [My Library](https://dndbeyond.com/en/library): Personal library of D&D sourcebooks, adventures, and digital content

## D&D Rules & Reference

- [D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024)](https://dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024): 2024 Basic Rules: game mechanics, abilities, D20 tests, character creation
- [Playing the Game - Basic Rules](https://dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game): Core gameplay rules: rhythm of play, player/DM roles, basic mechanics
- [Character Classes for D&D Fifth Edition (5e)](https://dndbeyond.com/classes): Complete 5e class list: Barbarian, Bard, Cleric, Fighter, and more
- [Monster Manual (2024)](https://dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/mm-2024): 2024 Monster Manual: stat blocks, creature entries, monster index
- [Basic Rules for D&D Fifth Edition (2014)](https://dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/basic-rules-2014): 5e Basic Rules and SRD: character creation, races, classes, gameplay
